storage.buckets.create: To create the bucket that archived data is written to.
storage.buckets.enableObjectRetention: To set object retention on the bucket, so each archived object can carry a retention time of its own.
storage.buckets.get: To get metadata of the bucket.
storage.buckets.update: To update configuration of the bucket.
storage.objects.create: To create each archived object in the bucket.
storage.objects.delete: To delete an archived object once its retention has passed.
storage.objects.get: To get data of each archived object when reading a backup back.
storage.objects.list: To list archived objects in the bucket.
storage.objects.setRetention: To set the retention of each archived object, so it cannot be deleted before it expires.
storage.objects.update: To update metadata of each archived object.
